choice_providers.label: Implement Schools
choice_providers.description: Choose two implement schools at 1st level and another at 2nd level and every 4 levels thereafter. A school may be selected more than once where the class rules allow it.

power_providers.label: Focus Powers
power_providers.description: Choose one additional focus power at 1st level and every odd level thereafter. Implement schools separately grant their base focus powers.

notes: Implement schools, their granted spell lists and base powers, invested mental focus, resonant powers, and selectable focus powers use separate reusable systems.
